rules.absent-delayed-dll: Delay-imported DLL absent from CiukiOS; a generated CiukiOS W21 stub DLL returns the documented failure per function (stub signatures), so delay binding succeeds and the caller sees failure (no theme, codec, trust provider or network).
rules.absent-forwarder-dll: Export forwarder into a DLL absent from CiukiOS; forwarders bind lazily, so the DLL loads and a binder of this export gets the W21 missing-export diagnostic.
rules.ciukios-stub-dll: Provided by an existing CiukiOS census/W21 DLL that lacks the export; add a W21 stub with the documented failure (no printer, no IME, no network provider).
rules.ciukios-version: CiukiOS VERSION implements the ANSI functions; the Unicode functions are added (core amendment).
rules.core-api: Documented Win32 API reached by the reused DLL; the owning CiukiOS core DLL implements it (amendment of the owning core directive).
rules.core-api-f5-20b: Win32 export outside the f5-14B table: imported by a reused DLL but then exported by the core only as a census or Unicode W21 stub (so the audit did not report it missing), or the ANSI/Unicode partner of a decided name; implemented by f5-20B (MSLU model for the W forms; amendment 2 item 1).
rules.core-api-f5-20c: Import bound to a nonreturning KERNEL32 census stub when the f5-20C re-audit ran; implemented in f5-20C (lead decision): IsBadReadPtr/IsBadWritePtr/IsBadCodePtr probe the range through the virtual-memory query and never fault, DebugBreak raises EXCEPTION_BREAKPOINT (int 3) as Windows does.
rules.core-census-w21: Import bound to an existing CiukiOS census or typed W21 stub (documented failure plus one W21 diagnostic); the reused DLL handles the failure. Recorded by the f5-20C re-audit (no Wine or core change).
rules.core-security-structures: Security descriptors and ACLs are plain data structures: the CiukiOS ADVAPI32 builds them in NT layout and object creation ignores them (no ACL enforcement on FAT); core amendment.
rules.core-uniscribe: Wine 10.0 moved Uniscribe (USP10) into GDI32 and RICHED20/COMCTL32 shape text through it; the CiukiOS GDI32 implements a left-to-right single-script subset (core amendment).
rules.kernelbase-internal: KERNELBASE-only API without a Windows 98 home; Wine-side patch compiles the upstream kernelbase unit into the importing DLL.
rules.kernelbase-retarget: Wine 10.0 links KERNELBASE, which Windows 98 lacks; a Wine-side Makefile/spec patch takes the function from its Windows 98 home DLL (pinned Wine spec), where the CiukiOS core already exports it.
rules.kernelbase-shlwapi-compile-in: SHLWAPI function that Wine 10.0 moved to KERNELBASE; Windows 98 SHLWAPI implemented it. Wine-side patch: compile the upstream kernelbase unit into the reused SHLWAPI.
rules.kernelbase-to-shlwapi: SHLWAPI function taken from KERNELBASE by another reused DLL; Wine-side patch retargets it to the reused SHLWAPI (after its compile-in).
rules.not-reused: The importing Wine build is measured but not reused; the entry disappears with it (see not_reused).
rules.ntdll-native: NT native API (Nt*/Rtl*/Ldr*) reached by the reused DLL; the CiukiOS NTDLL implements it over its own services (core amendment).
rules.ntdll-runtime: Compiler/CRT helper that NT NTDLL exports (64-bit arithmetic, stack probe, _vsnprintf); the CiukiOS NTDLL implements it (core amendment).
rules.w21-actctx: Activation contexts are Windows XP+; W21 stub failing with ERROR_CALL_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, which the callers treat as no context.
rules.w21-dpi: Per-monitor DPI internals (Windows 8.1+) reached only through SHCORE forwarders; W21 stub failing, callers fall back to 96 DPI.
rules.w21-msi: Windows Installer descriptors (advertised shortcuts) need MSI, which CiukiOS refuses (W32_REFUSE_MSI); W21 stub returning ERROR_CALL_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
rules.w21-nt-security: NT token/ACL services (file ACLs, privileges, user tokens, SID strings) are absent from Windows 9x and FAT; Windows 9x fails with ERROR_CALL_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; W21 stub with that failure.
rules.w21-services: Service Control Manager: Windows 9x has none and fails with ERROR_CALL_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; W21 diagnostic stub with that failure.
rules.w21-thread-description: Thread descriptions are Windows 10 diagnostics; W21 stub returning E_NOTIMPL.
rules.w21-wow64: WOW64 redirection exists only on 64-bit Windows; documented to fail on 32-bit Windows; W21 stub with ERROR_CALL_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
rules.wine-private: Wine-private helper with no Windows 98 meaning; a Wine-side source patch removes the call path. No Wine-private export enters the core.
